segments.sn27.10:1.2: “Yo, bhikkhave, rūpasmiṃ chandarāgo, cittasseso upakkileso … pe … yo viññāṇasmiṃ chandarāgo, cittasseso upakkileso.
segments.sn27.10:1.3: Yato kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno imesu pañcasu ṭhānesu cetaso upakkileso pahīno hoti, nekkhammaninnañcassa cittaṃ hoti.
segments.sn27.10:1.4: Nekkhammaparibhāvitaṃ cittaṃ kammaniyaṃ khāyati, abhiññā sacchikaraṇīyesu dhammesū”ti.
segments.sn27.10:1.6: Kilesasaṃyuttaṃ samattaṃ. Tassuddānaṃ – Cakkhu rūpañca viññāṇaṃ, phasso ca vedanāya ca; Saññā ca cetanā taṇhā, dhātu khandhena te dasāti.
